candidate.content: In a kitchen environment with multiple cabinets, saltshakers may be located inside closed lower cabinets. To acquire a saltshaker, the agent must navigate to a cabinet, open it (if closed), and take the item if present. The search process involves inspecting multiple containers sequentially until the target is found.
candidate.scope: Target acquisition phase for small household items (specifically saltshakers) in ALFRED-style kitchen environments where items are hidden within closed storage furniture.

direct_grounding.semantic_fact: The agent navigated to cabinet_6, which was initially closed.
Opening cabinet_6 revealed a dishsponge but no saltshaker, requiring further search.
The agent moved to cabinet_5, another closed container.
Opening cabinet_5 revealed it was empty, continuing the search.
The agent inspected cabinet_4, finding a cup and plate on top, but not the target.
The agent navigated to cabinet_2, which was closed.
Opening cabinet_2 revealed the target object: saltshaker_1.
The agent successfully took saltshaker_1 from cabinet_2, completing the acquisition.

minimal_global_context: The task required putting a saltshaker on a drawer, necessitating prior acquisition of the saltshaker.
Cabinets in this environment can contain multiple distinct items or be empty, and some require an 'open' action before contents are visible or accessible.
